messages.content: Use ONLY the file text editor tool (never bash), exactly one tool call per step, and continue even when a step fails: 1) create /tmp/c.txt containing "one two"; 2) str_replace "two" with "three" in /tmp/c.txt; 3) str_replace "nope" with "x" in /tmp/c.txt; 4) view /tmp/missing2.txt (it does not exist; do not create it); 5) create /tmp/c.txt again containing "overwritten". Then reply "done" and list the failed steps.
